summary: Daymark currently supports adding, completing, deleting, filtering, and persisting tasks, but existing tasks cannot be corrected or updated. Issue #2 requests editing for existing tasks.
requirements: A user can start editing an existing task from the task list.
A user can update the task title, notes, category, priority, and due date.
Saving updates the rendered task and browser storage.
A blank title cannot be saved.
The editing controls have accessible names and keyboard-operable actions.
constraints: Use the vendored harness workflow and preserve its run evidence.
Keep changes within the configured allowed paths and twelve-file budget.
Preserve existing add, complete, delete, filter, and persistence behavior.
Create a pull request only after the harness evaluation succeeds.
assumptions: Editing should cover every user-controlled field represented by the Todo type.
One task is edited at a time using an inline form.
Completed state is changed only through the existing completion control.

sources.summary: Open issue titled 'Add a feature to edit existing tasks.' requests correcting or updating an existing task.
